summary: Comprehensive testing of RS Burger premium website with enhanced step-by-step ordering flows. Backend APIs fully functional, frontend has routing and loading issues in business meals flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent loading issues - sometimes shows 'טוען...' (Loading...) indefinitely
ui_bugs.details: The 5-step business meals flow loads correctly sometimes but gets stuck in loading state other times. This affects the core new feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Inconsistent navigation to business-meals route from homepage cards
ui_bugs.details: Clicking business meals card from homepage doesn't always navigate to /business-meals route. Direct URL navigation works.

integration_issues.issue: API data loading delays causing UI to show loading state
integration_issues.details: Business meals component shows loading state when fetching products, salads, sauces, and drinks data

design_issues.issue: Menu navigation button not fully responsive on mobile

passed_tests: Hebrew RTL layout throughout the application
Premium design consistency with dark theme and golden accents
Homepage hero section and social proof
Salad selection options (הכל, יבש, לפי בחירה)
action_item_for_E1: Fix business meals step-by-step flow loading issues. The component sometimes gets stuck in loading state when fetching API data. Consider adding error handling and retry logic for API calls in BusinessMeals component. Also improve navigation routing consistency from homepage cards.

new_features_tested: 5-step business meals ordering flow (size → salads → extras → sauces → drinks)
Salads selection system with Hebrew options
Enhanced cart system with new item structure
Delivery zones for דאליית אל כרמל area
